users_display_name_length.name: users_display_name_length
users_display_name_length.value: "users"."display_name" IS NULL OR char_length("users"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 50

branches_time_zone_length.name: branches_time_zone_length
branches_time_zone_length.value: "branches"."time_zone" IS NULL OR char_length("branches"."time_zone") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

invitations_role_valid_for_kind.name: invitations_role_valid_for_kind
invitations_role_valid_for_kind.value:
(
  (organization_kind = 'provider' AND role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'staff')) OR
  (organization_kind = 'fleet' AND role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'driver', 'recruiter'))
)

invitations_single_outcome.name: invitations_single_outcome
invitations_single_outcome.value: NOT ("invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

memberships_role_valid_for_kind.name: memberships_role_valid_for_kind
memberships_role_valid_for_kind.value:
(
  (organization_kind = 'provider' AND role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'staff')) OR
  (organization_kind = 'fleet' AND role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'driver', 'recruiter'))
)

plan_assignments_subject.name: plan_assignments_subject
plan_assignments_subject.value:
("plan_assignments"."subject_type" = 'user' AND "plan_assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_assignments"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR
      ("plan_assignments"."subject_type" = 'organization' AND "plan_assignments"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_assignments"."user_id" IS NULL)

plan_assignments_ended_consistent.name: plan_assignments_ended_consistent
plan_assignments_ended_consistent.value: ("plan_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("plan_assignments"."ended_by" IS NULL) AND ("plan_assignments"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("plan_assignments"."end_reason" IS NULL)

plan_versions_price_complete.name: plan_versions_price_complete
plan_versions_price_complete.value: ("plan_versions"."price_minor" IS NULL) = ("plan_versions"."currency" IS NULL) AND ("plan_versions"."price_minor" IS NULL) = ("plan_versions"."billing_period" IS NULL)

quota_overrides_subject.name: quota_overrides_subject
quota_overrides_subject.value:
("quota_overrides"."subject_type" = 'user' AND "quota_overrides"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quota_overrides"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR
      ("quota_overrides"."subject_type" = 'organization' AND "quota_overrides"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quota_overrides"."user_id" IS NULL)

verification_appeals_decision_consistent.name: verification_appeals_decision_consistent
verification_appeals_decision_consistent.value: ("verification_appeals"."status" = 'open') = ("verification_appeals"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("verification_appeals"."status" = 'open' OR ("verification_appeals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("verification_appeals"."decision_reason") >= 3))

verification_badges_subject.name: verification_badges_subject
verification_badges_subject.value:
("verification_badges"."subject_type" = 'user' AND "verification_badges"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_badges"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR
      ("verification_badges"."subject_type" = 'organization' AND "verification_badges"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_badges"."user_id" IS NULL)

verification_badges_revocation_reason.name: verification_badges_revocation_reason
verification_badges_revocation_reason.value: "verification_badges"."end_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'revoked' OR ("verification_badges"."ended_by" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("verification_badges"."end_note") >= 3)

verification_cases_subject.name: verification_cases_subject
verification_cases_subject.value:
("verification_cases"."subject_type" = 'user' AND "verification_cases"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_cases"."organization_id" IS NULL) OR
      ("verification_cases"."subject_type" = 'organization' AND "verification_cases"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_cases"."user_id" IS NULL)

verification_cases_decision_consistent.name: verification_cases_decision_consistent
verification_cases_decision_consistent.value: ("verification_cases"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("verification_cases"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_cases"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)

verification_documents_size_range.name: verification_documents_size_range
verification_documents_size_range.value: "verification_documents"."declared_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760 AND ("verification_documents"."size" IS NULL OR "verification_documents"."size" BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760)

verification_documents_available_complet.name: verification_documents_available_complete
verification_documents_available_complet.value: "verification_documents"."status" <> 'available' OR ("verification_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_documents"."wrapped_key" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_documents"."iv" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_documents"."auth_tag" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_documents"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_documents"."available_at" IS NOT NULL)

provider_media_size_range.name: provider_media_size_range
provider_media_size_range.value: "provider_media"."declared_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND ("provider_media"."size" IS NULL OR "provider_media"."size" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880)

provider_media_available_complete.name: provider_media_available_complete
provider_media_available_complete.value: "provider_media"."status" <> 'available' OR ("provider_media"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_media"."available_at" IS NOT NULL)

provider_profiles_published_consistent.name: provider_profiles_published_consistent
provider_profiles_published_consistent.value: "provider_profiles"."status" <> 'published' OR ("provider_profiles"."published_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_profiles"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_profiles"."slug" IS NOT NULL)

provider_profiles_text_lengths.name: provider_profiles_text_lengths
provider_profiles_text_lengths.value:
("provider_profiles"."legal_name" IS NULL OR char_length("provider_profiles"."legal_name") <= 200) AND
          ("provider_profiles"."trading_name" IS NULL OR char_length("provider_profiles"."trading_name") <= 120) AND
          ("provider_profiles"."description" IS NULL OR char_length("provider_profiles"."description") <= 2000)

provider_offerings_price_shape.name: provider_offerings_price_shape
provider_offerings_price_shape.value:
("provider_offerings"."price_type" IN ('fixed', 'from') AND "provider_offerings"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_amount" > 0 AND "provider_offerings"."price_max" IS NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("provider_offerings"."price_type" = 'range' AND "provider_offerings"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_amount" > 0 AND "provider_offerings"."price_max" > "provider_offerings"."price_amount" AND "provider_offerings"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("provider_offerings"."price_type" = 'quote_required' AND "provider_offerings"."currency" IS NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_amount" IS NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_max" IS NULL AND "provider_offerings"."price_unit" IS NULL)

maintenance_schedules_interval.name: maintenance_schedules_interval
maintenance_schedules_interval.value: "maintenance_schedules"."interval_km" IS NOT NULL OR "maintenance_schedules"."interval_days" IS NOT NULL

vehicle_documents_encrypted_when_availab.name: vehicle_documents_encrypted_when_available
vehicle_documents_encrypted_when_availab.value: "vehicle_documents"."status" <> 'available' OR ("vehicle_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicle_documents"."wrapped_key" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicle_documents"."iv" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicle_documents"."auth_tag" IS NOT NULL)

vehicles_org_registration_key.name: vehicles_org_registration_key
vehicles_org_registration_key.where: "vehicles"."status" = 'active' AND "vehicles"."registration" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicles"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

vehicles_user_registration_key.name: vehicles_user_registration_key
vehicles_user_registration_key.where: "vehicles"."status" = 'active' AND "vehicles"."registration" IS NOT NULL AND "vehicles"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL

vehicles_branch_needs_org.name: vehicles_branch_needs_org
vehicles_branch_needs_org.value: "vehicles"."branch_id" IS NULL OR "vehicles"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

service_quotes_price_shape.name: service_quotes_price_shape
service_quotes_price_shape.value:
("service_quotes"."price_type" IN ('fixed', 'from') AND "service_quotes"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_amount" > 0 AND "service_quotes"."price_max" IS NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("service_quotes"."price_type" = 'range' AND "service_quotes"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_amount" > 0 AND "service_quotes"."price_max" > "service_quotes"."price_amount" AND "service_quotes"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("service_quotes"."price_type" = 'quote_required' AND "service_quotes"."currency" IS NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_amount" IS NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_max" IS NULL AND "service_quotes"."price_unit" IS NULL)

service_requests_requester.name: service_requests_requester
service_requests_requester.value:
("service_requests"."requester_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "service_requests"."requester_organization_id" IS NULL AND "service_requests"."requester_organization_kind" IS NULL AND "service_requests"."fleet_branch_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("service_requests"."requester_user_id" IS NULL AND "service_requests"."requester_organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "service_requests"."requester_organization_kind" = 'fleet')

community_groups_kind_fields.name: community_groups_kind_fields
community_groups_kind_fields.value: ("community_groups"."kind" = 'specialty' AND "community_groups"."specialty" IS NOT NULL) OR ("community_groups"."kind" <> 'specialty' AND "community_groups"."location_label" IS NOT NULL)

incident_recipients_kind_fields.name: incident_recipients_kind_fields
incident_recipients_kind_fields.value:
("incident_recipients"."kind" = 'contact' AND "incident_recipients"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incident_recipients"."organization_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("incident_recipients"."kind" = 'provider' AND "incident_recipients"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incident_recipients"."user_id" IS NULL)

conversations_kind_fields.name: conversations_kind_fields
conversations_kind_fields.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' AND "conversations"."direct_user_a" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_b" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_a" < "conversations"."direct_user_b" AND "conversations"."request_recipient_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."group_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."incident_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'request' AND "conversations"."request_recipient_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_a" IS NULL AND "conversations"."group_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."incident_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'group' AND "conversations"."group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_a" IS NULL AND "conversations"."request_recipient_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."incident_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'incident' AND "conversations"."incident_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."direct_user_a" IS NULL AND "conversations"."request_recipient_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."group_id" IS NULL)
